name: GaussianSet Data Structure
definition: A class representing a set of 3D Gaussians, storing means, orientations, scales, opacities, and spherical harmonics coefficients, and computing covariance matrices.
summary: The GaussianSet Data Structure is a class storing 3D Gaussian primitives as contiguous tensors for efficient batched processing, distinguishing itself by maintaining a flat list of primitives rather than using implicit neural fields or hierarchical spatial structures.
